items: Live unredacted student PII (first/last name, father's name, two mobile numbers, date of birth) stored in studentDB.accdb with no encryption, no database password and no authentication or authorization layer anywhere in the application (AuthenticationMode=0, no login form in any of the 4 forms).

The PII dataset sits in public source control alongside a confirmed, exploitable SQL-injection path (ViewForm.vb:50) capable of exfiltrating it - escalated upstream as escalation-record.json ESC-1 / trigger ET-1 against all five data-touching modules.
No audit trail and no provenance columns on the students table, and physical deletion with no recovery path, so a data subject's access, correction or erasure request cannot be serviced or evidenced.

No education-sector or privacy regulation (for example FERPA or GDPR) appears anywhere in the staged inputs. Whether any such regime applies is OUT OF SCOPE for this skill and unanswerable from the supplied artifacts; it is named here so the gap is explicit rather than silent.

consolidation_implication: None arising from regulation. The one consolidation cluster recorded in intra-app-redundancy.json (smsvb-student-record-crud: insert-form, edit-form, view-form) is justified entirely on entity, operation and persona overlap, with no regulatory-consistency component.
